# Zero Dollar Domains

> Catalog of programs that still give a $0 domain or subdomain, plus a live RDAP hunter for unused cheap-TLD names. Open cheap names get a registrar search link. Not an expired-.com auction dump. Not Freenom leftovers.

Site: https://arynjennen1989-stack.github.io/

## What this is

- Live RDAP checks against official registries (404 = unregistered, not “expired premium”).
- A snapshot of cheap-TLD names that were unregistered at last scan, with Spaceship / Porkbun search links.
- A graveyard of famous .coms that people assume dropped. They almost never did.
- Honest split: forever-free (eu.org, is-a.dev, thedev.id, github.io, FreeDNS, DuckDNS, ClouDNS) vs year-1 cheap (.xyz / .icu / .top).

## What this is not

- A leftover-.com scraper or WHOIS dump.
- A mass-registrar. We never register names for you.
- Freenom. Free .tk / .cf / .gq / .ga / .ml registrations ended in 2024.

## Pages

- [Home / hunter](https://arynjennen1989-stack.github.io/): type a word, check cheap TLDs + DNS, then claim or buy.
- [Board](https://arynjennen1989-stack.github.io/board.html): our RDAP harvest of open cheap names + dark-but-taken.
- [Catalog](https://arynjennen1989-stack.github.io/catalog.html): every $0 program we still stand behind.
- [Guides](https://arynjennen1989-stack.github.io/guides/): how to claim the $0 programs, and why leftover .coms are not free.
- [Guides feed](https://arynjennen1989-stack.github.io/guides/atom.xml)
- [Graveyard](https://arynjennen1989-stack.github.io/graveyard.html): live RDAP on famous shutdown .coms.
- [About](https://arynjennen1989-stack.github.io/about.html)
